# Repository instructions

Read and follow the root `AGENTS.md` before editing. It contains the owner's
full-motion requirement and the regression-check commands.

Never add or restore reduced/low-motion modes, motion-preference media gates,
or animation suppression based on devices, save-data, battery or inactivity.
Keep full animations and Journey scrollytelling enabled. Only a new explicit
request from Peter may change this policy; historical audits do not override it.
Preserve the motion regression tests and workflow.

Use `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` for the
static site's structure, design and project boundaries.
